# node-is-arrayish [![example.invalid Build Status](https://example.invalid/travis/Qix-/node-is-arrayish.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/Qix-/node-is-arrayish) [![example.invalid Coverage Rating](https://example.invalid/coveralls/Qix-/node-is-arrayish.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/r/Qix-/node-is-arrayish)
> Determines if an object can be used like an Array

## Example
```javascript
var isArrayish = require('is-arrayish');

isArrayish([]); // true
isArrayish({__proto__: []}); // true
isArrayish({}); // false
isArrayish({length:10}); // false
```
